message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
*(Note: Some holidays are province‑specific; the list below focuses on the national holidays that create long weekends across the country.)*

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | **Nov 9–11** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon) |

### Quick Notes

- **New Year’s Day (Jan 1)** fell on a Sunday in 2023, so it didn’t create an extra day off beyond the weekend.
- **Canada Day (Jul 1)** was on a Saturday, so no extra day off.
- **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** was on a Tuesday, so it didn’t extend the weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the various “Family Day” dates in other provinces), let me know and I can add those too.
